noAccess: Only instance admins can manage users and invitations.
usersIntro: Manage accounts and access across this Jekimo instance.
invitationsIntro: Invite people with a single-use link. Links are shared manually; email delivery is not configured.
noneInvitationsBody: Invite someone to create their account. Accepted, revoked, and expired invitations are excluded.
roleHelp: Admins can manage every project, account, and instance setting. Members only access projects they are added to.
lastAdmin: The instance must keep at least one active admin. Make another active user an admin first.
userMissing: This account is no longer available. Refresh the user list.

dialog.deactivateBody: This account will lose access immediately and all its sessions will end. Project memberships are kept for reactivation.
dialog.reactivateBody: This account can sign in again and regain access through its existing role and project memberships.
dialog.resetBody: The new link replaces any previous unused reset link. Using it changes the password and ends all sessions. Two-factor authentication stays enabled.
dialog.selfDeactivate: You are deactivating your own account. You will be signed out and another admin must reactivate you.
dialog.selfRole: Changing your own role to Member removes your instance administration access immediately.
dialog.revokeBody: The link will stop working. You can create a new invitation later.
dialog.inviteBody: Create an invitation link to share privately. A new invitation for the same email replaces the previous pending link.

link.warning: Copy this link now. It is shown only once and works once. Share it privately with the intended recipient; anyone with the link can use it.
link.label: Single-use link
link.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the link manually.
